steps.en: Install a release build, or run it from source on a folder of photos
steps.zh: 装好发布版，或从源码直接对一个照片文件夹运行

steps.en: Imports in place, skips duplicates, shows camera previews while it decodes the raws
steps.zh: 原地导入、跳过重复，边解码 RAW 边先显示相机预览

component.zh: 图库 + Rust RAW 解码器

steps.en: Cull the shoot with flags and star ratings
Open Edit or Masking and drag the sliders
steps.zh: 进入编辑或蒙版视图，拖动滑块

steps.en: Logs each change as an edit instruction and re-renders on the GPU; originals untouched
steps.zh: 把每次改动记成编辑指令，在 GPU 上重渲染，原片不动

steps.en: Export the picks with size, format and naming settings
steps.zh: 按尺寸、格式和命名规则导出选中的照片

steps.en: Writes JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, AVIF or DNG files with output sharpening and metadata policy
steps.zh: 写出 JPEG／TIFF／WebP／AVIF／DNG 等，带输出锐化

value.en: Lightroom-style cull, develop and export on your own machine — no subscription, no account, no cloud catalog
value.zh: 在自己电脑上完成 Lightroom 式的挑片、冲洗和导出：不用订阅，不要账号，图库不上云

sources: README.md: Quick start (cargo run --release -p lightcraft -- ~/Pictures/trip; folders are scanned, duplicates skipped)
